import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    size = 2 * n
    dp = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(size)]
    dp[0][1] = 1

    for i in range(1, size):
        prev = dp[i - 1]
        cur = dp[i]
        for j in range(n + 1):
            v = prev[j]
            if v != 0:
                if j + 1 <= n:
                    cur[j + 1] = (cur[j + 1] + v) % MOD
                if j - 1 >= 0:
                    cur[j - 1] = (cur[j - 1] + v) % MOD

    ans = 0
    for i in range(size - 2, -1, -2):
        limit = size - 1 - i
        for j in range(n + 1):
            if (j & 1) == 1 and j <= limit:
                ans = (ans + dp[i][j]) % MOD

    sys.stdout.write(str(ans))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
